thread:
deploybot: Canary rollout v2.10.0 -> group=usw2-small at 45% traffic. p50 stable, p95 +38% vs baseline, error rate +0.6%. Auto-rollback in 04:00 per canary-policy. https://deploys/redwood/2401234567 :warning:
amanda: On call. Can we hold auto-rollback? Looks like a KV-cache warmup spike to me, might settle if we pause traffic for a bit.
chris: +1 hold if safe. Was there a runtime/kernel tweak in this build?
jeff: there is a change: kv-cache-tuner=true in runtime flags. I think it's the culprit. Reverting the flag is lower risk than full revert.
maya: ops_oncall, can you run quick trace + host-level probes and call out any hot hosts?
ops_oncall: running probes now. curl health checks OK, pulling p95 flamegraphs. Tail spike concentrated on host-97, host-102, host-105. Collecting logs.
sara: comms note: if we manual rollback we need CS + customer-facing blurb and release note entry. Any Dedicated customers affected?
amanda: Only three Dedicated tenants on that pool: AcmeCorp, NovaPay, BeaconHealth. I've pinged CS OOO channel.
deploybot: Manual override ticket created by amanda. Auto-rollback canceled. Canary traffic frozen at 45%. :lock:
chris: Proposed plan: 1) drain problematic hosts 2) revert kv-cache-tuner flag 3) pin release to v2.9.0 for pool=usw2-small 4) monitor p95 for 10m. Who will run the steps?
jeff: I can run steps 2+3. Command from runbook: ```
# revert flag and pin
rcli config set --pool=usw2-small --key=kv-cache-tuner --value=false
rcli release pin --env=prod --pool=usw2-small --version=v2.9.0
```
ops_oncall: Draining hosts now: ```rcli pool drain --pool=usw2-small --hosts=host-97,host-102,host-105``` will shift traffic off and gracefully terminate new sessions.
maya: after drain, give 2m for caches to refill on remaining hosts, then check traces.
amanda: CS update sent: "We observed elevated latency during a small canary rollout. As a precaution we've rolled the canary back to the previous version for a limited pool. No action required from customers."
jeff: Pin + flag revert completed. Watching metrics. :eyes:
ops_oncall: p95 dropped back to baseline after ~3m post-revert. error rate back to normal. Drained hosts show increased GC noise while recovering.
maya: please add rollback note to release history and flag this as 'investigate: kv-cache tuner interaction with small pools' in the postmortem.
sara: I'll draft the customer note and update release notes. Also scheduling a short sync with runtime team tomorrow.
amanda: Good catch team. Recommend we disable auto-trigger for this specific flag until we have canary tests covering it. File a follow-up ticket. :thumbsup:
chris: Agree. Filing RFC for canary gating on runtime flags.
ops_oncall: Closing thread; will reopen if regressions appear.
